summary: Preserve AMC production and sandbox routing, official request headers, and the read-only movie-plan workflow across regeneration.
reason: AMC requires X-AMC-Vendor-Key rather than a generic bearer token, supports an optional user authorization token, and exposes low-level showtime reads that agents need combined into a safe planning workflow.
validated_outcome: Mock-HTTP tests prove official headers, sandbox selection, encoded paths and queries, response normalization, filtering, ranking, dry-run behavior, and invalid-argument handling without a live credential.
